import csv, hashlib, json
from pathlib import Path
base = Path('products/reviews/catalogue-editor-handoff')
report = json.loads((base / 'execution.json').read_text())
source = Path('products/services/catalogue-qa-agency-report/untouched-images.csv')
edited = base / 'editor-images.csv'
assert hashlib.sha256(source.read_bytes()).hexdigest() == report['input_sha256']
def rows(path):
    with path.open(newline='', encoding='utf-8-sig') as handle:
        return list(csv.reader(handle))
original = rows(source)
assert original[1] == original[13]
assert rows(edited) == original[:13] + original[14:]
negative = report['observations']['untouched-images.csv']
positive = report['observations']['editor-images.csv']
assert negative['exit_code'] == 2 and 'style SH-100: same image URL used twice' in negative['stderr']
assert positive['exit_code'] == 0
verification = json.loads(positive['stdout'].split('\n', 1)[1])
assert len(verification['checks']) == 12 and all(verification['checks'].values()) and not verification['failed']
print(json.dumps({'execution_evidence': str(base / 'execution.json'), 'editor_copy': str(edited), 'verified_checks': len(verification['checks']), 'manual_work': report['manual_work'], 'remaining_check': 'Read the bilingual report against the committed rehearsal and confirm the operator handoff before closing.'}))
